description:
Create a poll, check-in, availability board, or ranking and get a link to share with the group.

Easiest: pass `text` in plain language and SettleIt infers the type and options, e.g. "Dinner: pizza or thai" (poll), "Who's in for bowling Thursday?" (checkin), "Find a time for dinner next week" (availability), "Rank snacks: chips, popcorn, pretzels" (ranking).
For exact control, pass `question` plus `options` (2-5 for polls, 2-12 for rankings); with `question` alone you get a check-in. Availability must be created from `text`.
For availability, also pass the user's `timezone` (IANA name, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles") so the time slots are in their local time; without it slots are in UTC.

Returns the decision (share its `url`), plus an `admin_token` and `manage_url` to keep private.

closes_in_minutes.description: Polls only: auto-close after this many minutes.

text.description: Plain-language prompt. Max 200 characters except rankings.

timezone.description: Availability: the user's IANA time zone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Slots and words like "tomorrow" use it. Defaults to UTC.

type.description: Force a type. Optional with text.
